title: Bertoxxulous
summary: Clear the crypt's escalating defenders and kings to summon Bertoxxulous.
overview: Clear the crypt's escalating defenders and kings to summon Bertoxxulous.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Assemble before triggering the Spectre of Corruption sequence.
After the opening delay, rooms activate in succession. Control incoming defenders and track the named kings.
Clear the required enemies to bring out Bertoxxulous, preserving resources for the final fight.
The full event has a two-hour failure timer.
